title: SmartTab Mountain Quest, a story by Vijay
author: Vijay
synopsis: One mountain. One Main Station that won't come back online. Up to four new support agents. Every station in the valley is stuck on the gear screen, bars can't close tabs, and somewhere a bartender is taking orders on a napkin. From onboarding with Lady Kellie, through the MagTek Mines and over the ExpiTrans Bridge, up to a summit where a giant chrome toaster wears a crown — and Payam will not stop calling. A story by Vijay for 1-4 players from level 1 (rising to level 4); fellow new hires fill a small crew.

mq_start.title: Your First Day
mq_start.text:
Your first day. The new hires are lined up across from LADY KELLIE, Keeper of the Paperwork.

"Sign here, here, and here. Initial there. This one's the onboarding packet. All 40 pages. Nobody reads it."

effects.text: Lady Kellie: "Like the tiger from Life of Pi?" — "Never seen it." — (long pause)
Lady Kellie: "Support Agent. Say 'I completely understand your frustration.'" — "I completely understand your frustration." — "Perfect. You'll be saying that about 400 times a day."
Lady Kellie: "Field Tech. Here's a flashlight, knee pads, and a waiver. Sign that one first. The last Field Tech got stuck behind a beer cooler for three hours."
Lady Kellie: "Bartender? We're a tech company." (She thinks about it.) "Actually, Fridays have been rough. You're hired."
Lady Kellie: "Network Wizard. Do you have a wand?" (An ethernet cable is held up.) "Close enough."

pass.text: You read the whole thing. Lady Kellie has never seen anyone do this. She makes a note in your file.

fail.text: You skim it, like everyone else.

choices.label: Sign everything and head to the conference room

asides: Every great quest starts with paperwork. This one starts with forty pages of it.

mq_conference.title: The Big Conference Room
mq_conference.text:
Lady Kellie: "Congratulations, you're all officially employed. Your first emergency starts in five minutes."

Five minutes later, everyone is in the big conference room. BARON DANIEL BARON stands at the front. (Yes, the Baron is named Baron. Nobody asks.)

"The Main Station on top of SmartTab Mountain has gone dark. Every station in the valley is stuck on the gear screen. Bars can't close tabs. Kitchens can't print tickets. Somewhere out there, a bartender is taking orders on a napkin."

CAPTAIN JD slides a headset across the table to each of you. "Everybody else is on the phones. You're all new, none of you have a queue yet, and you've all got working legs. Congratulations, you're going up the mountain."

npc.name: Baron Daniel Baron
npc.title: (Yes, the Baron is named Baron)
npc.line: The Main Station on top of SmartTab Mountain has gone dark.

choices.label: Grab your headset and head out

mq_printer.title: The Office Printer
mq_printer.text:
On the way out, the office printer starts making a noise. A very bad noise.

*** THE PAPER JAM GOBLIN *** — A little gremlin made of crumpled receipts crawls out of the paper tray.

victory.text: The goblin flees into the paper tray. The printer spits out one ticket that just says "sorry."

defeat.text: The goblin wins this round, then gets bored and wanders back into the paper tray. The printer spits out one ticket that just says "sorry."

mq_first_fix.title: First Fix of the Day
mq_first_fix.text:
The orange light on the printer is blinking. Someone presses Feed. It clears. First fix of the day.

Then a desk phone rings. Nobody has even sat down yet.

mq_payam1.title: Payam, Monroe
mq_payam1.text: "This is Payam. Monroe. My station's been down four minutes. FOUR. Do you know how much money I lose in four minutes?"

npc.name: Payam
npc.title: Monroe
npc.line: My station's been down four minutes. FOUR.

choices.label: "I'm sorry, we're working on it right now."

pass.text: Payam: "Work faster." Click. You stay calm the whole time. He doesn't say thank you. Nobody expected him to. (+10 tips)

fail.text: Payam: "Work faster." Click. You let out a tiny sigh. He heard it. Payam calls back: "Did you just sigh at me? Fuck you." Click.

choices.label: "Have you tried turning it off and on?"

effects.text: Payam: "That's YOUR job." He hangs up. You feel ten years older.

choices.label: "Can I put you on a brief hold?"

effects.text: You've never put anyone on hold in your life. You picked a bad time to start. Payam: "Do NOT put me on hold. Fuck you." Click. You feel ten years older.

mq_mines.title: The MagTek Mines
mq_mines.text:
At the foot of SmartTab Mountain, the road turns into a mine. Beeps echo out of the dark. Two beeps. Four beeps. Ten beeps.

A goblin in a headset is waiting at the entrance. This is DRE.

npc.name: Dre the Goblin
npc.title: Guide
npc.line: Stay close, and don't touch anything that's blinking.

choices.label: Ask Dre about the goblin in the office printer

effects.text: Dre: "That was my cousin Gary. We don't talk about Gary."

mq_lift.title: The Lift
mq_lift.text:
The lift down into the mines keeps flipping between WE'LL BE BACK MOMENTARILY and working.

Dre: "Somebody set this cable up way too tight. Every time the lift moves, it yanks itself out." He hands you the cable.

npc.name: Dre the Goblin
npc.title: Guide
npc.line: Somebody set this cable up way too tight.

effects.text: It reboots. It works for ten seconds. Then WE'LL BE BACK MOMENTARILY. Dre: "Rebooting doesn't fix a cable."
Your foot hurts. The lift doesn't care.

choices.label: Reseat the cable and leave some slack

pass.text: You reseat it and leave some slack. The lift hums to life and stays on. Dre nods. That's the only compliment anyone's getting today.

fail.text: You reseat it, but pull it tight again out of habit. It pops right back out. Try again.

mq_tunnel.title: The Hidden Button
mq_tunnel.text:
Halfway down the tunnel, a station in the wall is stuck on the gear screen.

Dre: "Watch. Top right corner, there's a hidden button." He taps it. A banner pops up with the IP. It's pointed at the wrong main. Dre fixes it in about four seconds.

"Remember that. Hidden button, top right. You're gonna need it." Everyone writes it on their hand.

Something drifts out of an old card reader further down the tunnel…

victory.text: The Poltergeist finally gets its card removed and fades away.

mq_payam2.title: Payam, Again
mq_payam2.text:
Your phone rings. The caller ID says MONROE. Dre sees it and backs away slowly.

"Why is it so loud on your end?" — "I'm in a mine." — "I don't care where you are. My cocktail server can't clock out. It says Access Denied. She wants to go home. I want her to go home. I'm not paying her to stand there."

npc.name: Payam
npc.title: Monroe
npc.line: Why is it so loud on your end?

effects.text: Payam: "I rebooted it six times. It reboots fine. She still can't clock out."

choices.label: Turn off "fingerprint required" so she can clock out with her code, then turn it back on and re-enroll her

effects.text: Payam: "Did you just tell MY employee to stay? I'M the one who tells people to stay."

mq_payam2_fp.title: Clocked Out
mq_payam2_fp.text: She clocks out with her code. Now, don't forget the second half…

choices.label: Turn fingerprints back on and re-enroll her

pass.text: You turn "fingerprint required" back on and re-enroll her. Payam hangs up without a word. That's as close as he gets to thank you. (+15 tips)

fail.text: You forget to turn it back on. An hour later, Payam calls back: "Why is someone named GARY clocked in at my bar?" You turn it back on. Somewhere in the mine, Dre gets very quiet. (+5 tips)

mq_reader.title: The Three-Headed Reader
mq_reader.text: Deeper in, a card reader with three heads blocks the tunnel. One screams INSERT, one screams SWIPE, one screams TAP. Whatever you do, two of them are mad about it.

victory.text: All three heads go quiet at once. For the first time, they agree on something.

mq_free_box.title: FREE
mq_free_box.text: A brand-new card reader, still sealed in the box, sits in the middle of the tunnel. The box just says FREE.

victory.text: The Mimic stops chewing. Inside: a few tips somebody else reached for first.

pass.text: It has teeth. It has packing tape on the teeth. You leave it alone, and it sulks.

fail.text: It looks like a perfectly good free card reader.

mq_tamper.title: Four Lights
mq_tamper.text: In the dark, a card reader sits alone. Four lights blinking, over and over.

npc.name: Dre the Goblin
npc.title: Guide
npc.line: Four lights. That's tamper. It's done.

effects.text: You hold the button and count. Eight... nine... ten. The four lights keep blinking. It didn't even notice. Dre: "Four lights means tamper. Tamper means it's done. Don't be a hero."
That felt good. It didn't fix anything.

choices.label: Box it up and send for a replacement

effects.text: It's the right call. It's also the saddest box anyone has ever taped. Dre: "New one's on the way. When it shows up, unplug the old one, plug in the new one, and do a full reboot on the station. And Velcro it so it sticks up."

mq_sir_gate.title: Sir Declines-a-Lot
mq_sir_gate.text:
At the bottom of the mine, something enormous is standing in front of the exit. It clanks.

"Halt! I decline your request to pass." — "I didn't request anything." — "Declined."

npc.name: Sir Declines-a-Lot
npc.title: Guardian of the Mine Exit
npc.line: Halt! I decline your request to pass.

pass.text: Two lights, not four. Dre, from behind a rock: "He's not in tamper, he's just confused. Hold the button!"

fail.text: Lots of lights. Blinking. You're not sure what they mean.

pass.text: ...eight, nine, ten. Sir Declines-a-Lot freezes. Reboots. When he comes back up, his armor is gone and he's forgotten how to decline. (He starts the fight weakened.)

fail.text: You lose count at seven. The reset didn't take. He raises his shield. DECLINED.

mq_sir_fight.title: DECLINED
mq_sir_fight.text: Sir Declines-a-Lot draws a sword made of expired cards.

victory.text: Sir Declines-a-Lot drops to one knee. His visor flickers one last time: APPROVED.

mq_mines_end.title: Out of the Mines
mq_mines_end.text:
Dre: "I've got a queue. One more thing. If you ever see the white pill flashing white, leave it alone. It's still booting. Wait for blue." Dre heads back toward HQ.

**LEVEL UP!** Everyone is now level 2.

Captain JD (on Slack): "nice work. keep going." Buttram had Joel send an Energy Drink up the mountain with a note: "Payam called again."

npc.name: Dre the Goblin
npc.title: Guide
npc.line: If you ever see the white pill flashing white, leave it alone.

mq_bridge.title: The ExpiTrans Bridge
mq_bridge.text:
The only way up the mountain crosses a canyon. The bridge is old. Half the planks say APPROVED. Half say DECLINED.

Everybody has to cross, so everybody rolls.

pass.text: You step only on APPROVED planks and make it across without a wobble.

fail.text: You step on a DECLINED plank. Insufficient support. You drop through, land on a ledge, and climb back up sticking to the APPROVED ones this time.

mq_payam3.title: Your Manager
mq_payam3.text:
As everyone steps off the bridge, a phone rings. MONROE.

"I want to talk to your manager." — "Captain JD is..." — "I want to talk to HIS manager." — "That'd be Baron Daniel Baron." — "Then put the Baron on."

Somewhere, Baron Daniel Baron's phone starts ringing.

npc.name: Payam
npc.title: Monroe
npc.line: I want to talk to your manager.

pass.text: You stay calm the whole time. He doesn't say thank you. Nobody expected him to. (+10 tips)

fail.text: You let out a tiny sigh. He heard it. "Did you just sigh at me? Fuck you." Click.

mq_troll_gate.title: Under the Bridge
mq_troll_gate.text:
On the far side, there's a little hut with a lantern in the window and a sign: EXPITRANS. And under the end of the bridge, something huge stirs.

"WHO GOES THERE? Toll is 100 tips. Also, I'm disputing your last three transactions." — "I haven't bought anything." — "Then you won't mind."

(Every open dispute heals him. Somebody needs to resolve those disputes.)

npc.name: Chargeback Troll
npc.title: Under the Bridge
npc.line: WHO GOES THERE? Toll is 100 tips.

effects.text: You pay the troll 100 tips. He immediately disputes the payment and attacks anyway.

victory.text: The troll sinks back under the bridge, mumbling about a 45-day window. A business card flutters out of his visor. It just says TOAST.
The troll sinks back under the bridge, mumbling about a 45-day window. A business card flutters out of his visor. It just says TOAST.

mq_bridge_end.title: TOAST
mq_bridge_end.text:
The business card just says TOAST. Somebody is behind all of this.

**LEVEL UP!** Everyone is now level 3.

mq_steve.title: Cowboy Steve's Supplies
mq_steve.text:
At the base of the trail, there's a covered wagon with a hand-painted sign: COWBOY STEVE'S SUPPLIES.

"Howdy, partners. Headin' up the mountain? You'll want some Energy Drinks. Price includes the Red Bull tax. Don't look at me, I don't make the rules. Zip ties are over here. They won't fix it, but they'll keep it from comin' loose."

(The tips are shared, so don't get greedy.)

npc.name: Cowboy Steve
npc.title: Purveyor of Supplies
npc.line: Howdy, partners. Headin' up the mountain?

choices.label: Energy Drink — 20 tips (+5 Red Bull tax)

effects.text: 20 for the drink, 5 for the Red Bull tax.
Cowboy Steve says it doesn't work on Payam. It makes him stronger.
Cowboy Steve: "Happy trails."

mq_sage.title: Sage Larson
mq_sage.text:
Halfway up the mountain, there's a hut with smoke coming out of the chimney. The door opens before anyone knocks.

"You've come about the Main Station." — "I haven't said anything yet." — "You were going to."

"Before you touch anything, listen for the heartbeat between the station and the main. Let it beat the whole time. Count the beats that never come back."

JR: "He means run a ping test first, leave it running, and look for dropped packets." — Sage Larson: "I was getting there."

Sage Larson hands everyone a cup of tea before anyone can ask for one. (Everyone's back to full HP.) "Take my son with you. He needs field experience." — JR: "I've been ready for months." — "Weeks."

**JR the Apprentice joins the party!** He'll smack enemies with a patch cable.

npc.name: Sage Larson
npc.title: Hermit of the Mountain
npc.line: You've come about the Main Station.

choices.label: Thank Sage Larson and head up the trail

mq_latency_gate.title: Lord Latency
mq_latency_gate.text:
The trail gets steep. Up ahead, a skeleton in a robe of tangled patch cables is blocking the path. His mouth is already moving.

"Welcome." (He said that four seconds ago.) "You're too late." — "Says the guy whose words show up after his mouth stops moving."

"I am ancient. I run on build 3.10." — JR: "Engineers won't even look at anything under 8." — "...I know. That's why I work for Toast now. My king is waiting at the summit."

choices.label: Run a ping test first (like Sage Larson said)

effects.text: You start a ping test to the Main Station and leave it running. JR: "900 milliseconds. Normal's 50. It's not you, it's the network." (Lord Latency starts the fight weakened.)

victory.text: Lord Latency fades out like a dropped connection. Four seconds later, everyone hears him say "ow."

effects.text: He's only registering 4 of his 12 gigs. You reseat it. Now he's got all 12. He's way faster, and his words show up on time. Somehow that's worse. JR: "Old habits." (+15 tips for excellent customer service. He hits harder now.)

victory.text: Lord Latency fades out like a dropped connection. Right on time, he says "ow."
Lord Latency fades out like a dropped connection. Four seconds later, everyone hears him say "ow."

mq_latency_end.title: Higher Up
mq_latency_end.text:
**LEVEL UP!** Everyone is now level 4.

Higher up, a station sits in the snow, stuck on the gear screen. It turns toward the party. Slowly.

Everyone looks down at their hands. Dre's note is still there.

pass.text: The banner pops up. It's been pointed at the wrong main this whole time. You repoint it. The Revenant finds its way home and fades away. It was never evil. It was just lost.

fail.text: You tap the top LEFT. That's the power icon. Wrong corner. It lurches toward you…

mq_revenant.title: The Gear-Screen Revenant
mq_revenant.text: The Revenant crashes toward you. It isn't trying to. It's just loading.

victory.text: The gear stops spinning. The Revenant finally finishes loading — straight into a login screen — and goes still.

mq_white_pill.title: The White Pill
mq_white_pill.text:
Right below the summit, a giant white pill-shaped tower is blocking the path. Its light is off. Nothing past it has power.

JR: "Dad would say follow the cable."

effects.text: You kick it. It's a network device, not a vending machine. The light stays off.

choices.label: Follow its power cable, unplug it, wait 30 seconds, plug it back in

effects.text: You follow the cable. It's black, not white, which is why nobody could find it. Unplug. Thirty seconds. Plug it back in. The light comes on solid white. Then it starts flashing white.

choices.label: Wait for it to come back on by itself

effects.text: Nothing happens. It isn't getting power. It's never coming back on by itself.

mq_flashing.title: Flashing White
mq_flashing.text:
Flashing white. Flashing white. Flashing white.

JR: "Didn't Dre say something about this?"

choices.label: Unplug it again, it's taking too long

effects.text: Back to solid white. Then flashing white again. JR sighs the same sigh his dad does.
Still flashing white. Now your hand hurts too.

choices.label: Leave it alone and wait for blue

pass.text: Flashing white... Flashing white... Solid BLUE. The tower hums, and the path to the summit lights up. Nobody did anything, and it was the right call.

fail.text: Somebody's hand drifts toward the power cable. JR slaps it away. Try again.

mq_summit.title: The Summit
mq_summit.text:
At the summit, the Main Station sits on a rock, completely dark. Standing over it is a giant chrome toaster wearing a crown. A sales rep lanyard hangs off his lever. Next to him, a small, nervous square is holding his cape.

"Every venue in this valley that goes offline gets a call from one of my reps within the hour. I've already got someone headed to Monroe." — "Monroe? Payam's Monroe?" — "...Is that bad?" — JR: "You'll see."

Squire Square: "We have free hardware!" — The Toast King: "Not now, Square."

pass.text: "SmartTab actually answers the phone." Squire Square has never heard of that. "Do you guys have free hardware?" — "We have Cowboy Steve." — "...I'm in." (Squire Square switches sides!)

fail.text: Squire Square says he'll think about it. He won't.

pass.text: Page 47. The 90-day out clause. His contract can't hold anyone anymore. (The Toast King starts the fight weakened.)

mq_offline.title: MAIN STATION OFFLINE
mq_offline.text:
The Toast King wobbles. Then he slams his lever down. Every station in the valley flips to MAIN STATION OFFLINE.

"Somebody say wrong main IP?" Dre bursts in, completely out of breath. He ran up the entire mountain.

You tap the top right corner. The banner pops up. Every station in the valley is pointed at a Toast server.

choices.label: Repoint every station to the real Main Station

pass.text: Dre repoints them with you. One by one, every station in the valley turns back toward the real Main Station. The Toast King: "Fine. Keep your venues. ...Can I at least have Monroe?" His crown falls off. He's just a toaster now. Squire Square picks up the crown and quietly puts it in his pocket.

fail.text: Dre: "Again!" The Toast King burns you mid-fix.

mq_payam4.title: A Car at the Summit
mq_payam4.text:
The Main Station is right there. You pick it up. It's still warm.

Then a car pulls up at the summit. There is no road up here. Nobody knows how he did it.

"I drove up. You were taking too long. Is it fixed? It's not fixed. Why isn't it fixed? Also, my bartenders want the old keyboard back."

From the ground, the Toast King looks up. "Is this Monroe?" — Payam: "Who the fuck is this toaster?"

You're holding the Main Station.

npc.name: Payam
npc.title: Monroe
npc.line: I drove up. You were taking too long.

choices.label: Plug the Main Station back in
Throw the Main Station at Payam's head

pass.text: You wind up. You've never been more sure of anything. BONK. Payam stops talking. For the first time, Payam stops talking.

fail.text: You wind up... it slips, bounces twice, and lands perfectly in its slot. Everything comes back online. Payam: "Took you long enough. Fuck you." He drives back down the mountain. He does not say thank you.

mq_back_online.title: Back Online
mq_back_online.text:
One by one, the lights come back across the valley. Gear screens turn into login screens. Somewhere, a bartender throws away a napkin.

Back at SmartTab HQ, Buttram tells Joel he can finally take his headset off. Then Buttram takes his off too.

Sage Larson: "I knew it would work." — JR: "He did. He always does." — Dre: "Nobody unplugged the white pill while it was flashing, right?" — Everyone: "Nobody unplugged it."

Baron Daniel Baron: "Outstanding work. Take the rest of the day off." — Captain JD: "It's 4:58."

Then the phone rings. Everyone freezes. "Hey, it's Mark Piazza from Old Almaden. Everything's working great. Just wanted to call and say thanks."

**ENDING: BACK ONLINE**

mq_quick_chat.title: Quick Chat
mq_quick_chat.text:
JR quietly picks up the Main Station and plugs it back in. The valley comes back online. Nobody mentions what just happened.

Payam sits up. He looks around. "...Is it fixed?" — "It's fixed." — "Fuck you." He gets back in his car and drives down a mountain that has no road.

That night, Monroe leaves SmartTab a one-star review: "Got hit in the head with a Main Station. Worked fine afterward though."

Captain JD (on Slack): "heard what happened. legend." ... "dont tell kellie i said that"

Then your calendar pings. *Lady Kellie: Quick chat? Location: My office. Duration: As long as it takes. Attached: Onboarding Packet, page 31.*

effects.text: Page 31 is one sentence, in bold: DO NOT THROW HARDWARE AT THE CLIENTS. Baron Daniel Baron adds a page to the onboarding packet. It's 41 pages now.

choices.label: You already know what page 31 says

effects.text: You read the whole onboarding packet. You knew exactly what page 31 says. You did it anyway. Baron Daniel Baron adds a page to the onboarding packet. It's 41 pages now.

choices.label: ENDING: QUICK CHAT — roll the credits

mq_churned.title: Churned
mq_churned.text:
You take the crown out of Squire Square's pocket, put it back on the Toast King, and hand him a sticky note with Payam's number on it.

The Toast King: "Pleasure doing business." — Payam: "Fuck you. All of you."

JR plugs the Main Station back in. The valley comes back online. Every venue except one. Monroe switches to Toast that afternoon.

Six hours later, Toast's support line gets its first call from Payam. By Friday, Toast's entire support team has quit. The Toast King moves back into a kitchen. He makes toast now. He seems happier.

On Monday morning, the phone rings at SmartTab HQ. "It's Payam. Monroe. I want to come back." — Baron Daniel Baron: "We'll think about it." — Buttram: "Joel, take this one." — Joel: "I'll take this one."

**ENDING: CHURNED**

mq_credits.title: Thanks for Playing SmartTab Mountain Quest
mq_credits.text:
**Starring:** your new hires, Dre the Goblin, Sage Larson, JR the Apprentice, Captain JD, Lady Kellie, Baron Daniel Baron, Buttram (Senior Holder of the Line), Joel (Holder of the Line), Cowboy Steve, Lord Latency, The Toast King, Squire Square, and Payam the Demanding ....... as himself.

*A story by Vijay.*

choices.label: No stations were harmed in the making of this game.

effects.text: No stations were harmed in the making of this game.

choices.label: No stations were harmed in the making of this game. One was thrown.

effects.text: No stations were harmed in the making of this game. One was thrown.

choices.label: No stations were harmed in the making of this game. One venue was churned. It came back.

effects.text: No stations were harmed in the making of this game. One venue was churned. It came back.

mq_printer.title: The Paper Jam Goblin
mq_printer.intro: A gremlin of crumpled receipts and its paper friends pour out of the printer. Nobody gets hurt on day one (much).

mq_poltergeist.title: The Please Remove Card Poltergeist
mq_poltergeist.intro: "PLEASE REMOVE CARD." You don't have a card in. It doesn't care.

mq_reader.title: The Three-Headed Reader
mq_reader.intro: INSERT! SWIPE! TAP! Whatever you do, two of them are mad about it.

mq_mimic.title: The Mimic
mq_mimic.intro: The box says FREE. It has teeth.

mq_sir.title: Sir Declines-a-Lot
mq_sir.intro: A knight built out of old card readers blocks the exit. His visor reads DECLINED. (Did you look at his lights?)

phases.text: Dre, from behind a rock: "Look at his lights! He's not in tamper, he's just confused!"

effects.text: "DECLINED. DECLINED. DECL—"

mq_troll.title: The Chargeback Troll
mq_troll.intro: The Chargeback Troll is buried in paperwork. While his OPEN DISPUTES stand, he gets his HP back every turn — resolve them (smash the paperwork)! The canyon is right there: shove him in if you can.

phases.text: Somebody's phone rings mid-fight. Buttram: "Buttram here. I've got Joel on the line too. I found the signed receipts. They were in the drawer under the other drawer. Joel, send them." Joel: "Sending them now."

effects.text: Buttram: "Also, Payam called. Twice. Joel took both." Joel: "I took both."

mq_latency.title: Lord Latency
mq_latency.intro: Everything Lord Latency does arrives four seconds late — except the LAG SPIKES. Dropped Packets swarm around him. JR is with you, smacking things with a patch cable.

phases.text: LAG SPIKE! Everyone's screens freeze… and everything lands at once.

effects.text: "...ow." (He said that four seconds ago.)

mq_latency_fast.title: Lord Latency
mq_latency_fast.intro: Everything Lord Latency does arrives four seconds late — except the LAG SPIKES. Dropped Packets swarm around him. JR is with you, smacking things with a patch cable.

phases.text: LAG SPIKE! Everyone's screens freeze… and everything lands at once.

effects.text: "...ow." (He said that four seconds ago.)

mq_revenant.title: The Gear-Screen Revenant
mq_revenant.intro: A station stuck on the gear screen for three days. It's not angry. It's just loading.

mq_toast_king.title: The Toast King
mq_toast_king.intro: THE TOAST KING. Both slots glow red. He's set to dark, his Auto-Renewal Clause slows anyone it catches, and he has three outage spells ready. JR fights with you — and Squire Square, if you recruited him.

phases.text: THE TOAST KING CASTS: TRANSACTION REVERSAL. A receipt prints. A closed tab pops back open! JR: "The system never reverses on its own. Someone hit Refund!" You recharge the tab — but he's already toasted himself back up a little.

effects.text: "See? The system reverses on its own. You'd never have this problem with Toast."

phases.text: THE TOAST KING CASTS: THE VANISHING. Every open tab disappears — and Flying Croutons pour out of his slots! (Somebody had the screen filtered. Press the pink Drop All Filters button!)
THE TOAST KING CASTS: THE FAKE REBOOT. His slots go dark... four seconds later, they're glowing red again. JR: "That was suspiciously fast." The summit's rocks start sparking!

effects.text: "Not now, Square."

monsters.name: The Paper Jam Goblin
monsters.blurb: A little gremlin made of crumpled receipts. Tastes like thermal paper.

monsters.name: The Please Remove Card Poltergeist
monsters.blurb: A ghost from an old card reader. It only knows one sentence. You don't have a card in.

monsters.name: The Three-Headed Reader
monsters.blurb: One head screams INSERT, one screams SWIPE, one screams TAP. Whatever you do, two of them are mad.

monsters.name: The Mimic
monsters.blurb: A brand-new card reader, still sealed. The box just says FREE. It has teeth.

monsters.name: Sir Declines-a-Lot
monsters.blurb: A knight built out of old card readers. His visor reads DECLINED.

monsters.name: The Chargeback Troll
monsters.blurb: A huge troll in a green visor, buried up to his neck in paperwork. Every open dispute heals him.

monsters.name: Open Dispute
monsters.blurb: A stack of chargeback paperwork. While it's open, the troll keeps getting his money back. Resolve it (hit it)!

monsters.name: Lord Latency
monsters.blurb: A skeleton in a robe of tangled patch cables. Everything he does arrives four seconds late. Runs build 3.10.

monsters.name: Lord Latency (All 12 Gigs)
monsters.blurb: You reseated his RAM. Now all 12 gigs are registering, his words show up on time, and somehow that's worse.

monsters.name: Dropped Packet
monsters.blurb: It never came back. Now it's back, and it's angry about the wait.

monsters.name: The Gear-Screen Revenant
monsters.blurb: A station stuck on the gear screen for three days. It's not angry. It's just loading.

monsters.name: The Toast King
monsters.blurb: A giant chrome toaster wearing a crown, a sales-rep lanyard hanging off his lever. He's set to dark.

monsters.name: Flying Crouton
monsters.blurb: The Toast King's spare slices. Still warm.

monsters.name: JR the Apprentice
monsters.blurb: Sage Larson's son. Has been ready for months. (Weeks.)

monsters.name: Squire Square
monsters.blurb: Switched sides. Goes through on the first try.

monsters.name: Dre the Goblin
monsters.blurb: Ran up the entire mountain. Somebody said wrong main IP.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.desc: A big heal: restores 2d8+8 hit points. (Includes the Red Bull tax.) Bonus Action.

items.name: Hold Music
items.desc: Nobody at SmartTab actually puts anyone on hold, so nothing has ever heard this song. Ranged (20 ft): 2d6 psychic as the target stands there tapping its foot. (Cowboy Steve says it doesn't work on Payam. It makes him stronger.)

items.name: Bag of Zip Ties
items.desc: They won't fix it, but they'll keep it from comin' loose. +1 Armor Class (attune from your sheet).

pregens.name: Richard Parker
pregens.appearance: Support Agent. Brand-new headset, brand-new lanyard, has never seen Life of Pi.
pregens.personality: Can say "I completely understand your frustration" 400 times a day and mean it every time.

pregens.name: Jordan the Field Tech
pregens.appearance: Field Tech. Flashlight, knee pads, and a signed waiver. The toughest new hire.
pregens.personality: Has a special move called Power Cycle Slam and is waiting for any excuse to use it.
pregens.motto: Hold the switch down. Count to thirty.

pregens.name: Sam the Bartender
pregens.appearance: Bartender. Hired because "Fridays have been rough." Pours a Double that could wake the dead.
pregens.personality: Keeps everyone on their feet and the tips coming in.

pregens.name: Alex the Network Wizard
pregens.appearance: Network Wizard. His wand is an ethernet cable. Lady Kellie said that was close enough.
pregens.personality: Fragile, brilliant, and convinced every problem is DNS.

pregens.name: Casey (New Hire, Bartender)
pregens.appearance: Another new hire. Brought her own shaker.
pregens.personality: Pours doubles for anyone who goes down.

pregens.name: Morgan (New Hire, Field Tech)
pregens.appearance: Another new hire. Already has a zip tie behind each ear.
pregens.personality: Got stuck behind a beer cooler once. Doesn't talk about it.
